subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed review completion gate in this PR, or should the review gate use the existing status model?
rationale: The PR introduces a model-facing tool and persistent lifecycle state that can change existing Workboard completion behavior at runtime, so maintainers need to confirm the intended product contract before a repaired version lands.

options.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
options.body: Preserve existing response contracts, require review proof for every completion, declare the new tool, update UI/status consumers, add tests, and require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign on existing statuses
options.body: Avoid adding `ready_to_merge` until maintainers want that durable state, and enforce the review gate through the current `review`/`done` lifecycle instead.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close or defer the PR if Workboard review gates should stay process-driven rather than enforced by tool-level fail-closed behavior for now.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Preserve existing response contracts, require review proof for every completion, declare the new tool, update UI/status consumers, add tests, and require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The path history shows the broadest ownership of Workboard lifecycle, manifest, status, and UI surfaces affected by this product decision.
